# Original woodland-v2 regression fixtures

These two original project-authored GLBs are preserved from source commit 1a6eeeed9c6134a0421a7536b53a12e4153bbd9a solely to test the legacy rigid-avatar batching derivation. They are not shipping woodland-v4 models. Their authored clips and exact surfaces let tests retain coverage of the supported old batching interface while articulated models safely fall back without collapsing animated joints. No external model or licence dependency was introduced.
